overview: The Community Development Board approved a site plan review for 400 Riverside Avenue with eight conditions. It also reviewed revised designs for 360 Salem Street before continuing the hearing to March 18, and held an informal discussion regarding proposed Medford Square zoning changes.

items.title: Site plan review: 400 Riverside Ave
items.summary: Approved the site plan review application by Able Companies with eight conditions addressing sidewalk restoration, roof drainage, fire department access, and parking prohibitions.

items.title: Site plan review: 360 Salem Street
items.summary: Closed public comment and continued the public hearing to March 18, 2026, to allow staff and the building commissioner to review parking requirements, zoning waivers, and draft conditions.

items.title: Medford Square zoning amendments discussion
items.summary: Held an informal discussion following a joint City Council meeting regarding lot coverage definitions, dimensional standards, zoning overlays, historic preservation incentives, and senior center parking.

items.title: Approval of minutes and administrative updates
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from December 3, 2025, and reviewed administrative follow-ups regarding Mullen rule affidavits.
